contribution.position: Holding my earlier position with new corroboration: answering the ops role's claim that a failover drill proves the rollback path — the cited artifact:failover-drill-2026-09 does not appear in the artifact list, and the actual artifact:ops-runbook states no failover drill has been executed, with the last drill still marked planned. So the rollback claim rests on a nonexistent artifact and is contradicted by the runbook. Combined with artifact:incident-log's two sev2 retry-storm incidents, reliability evidence for retry-storm behavior remains outstanding.
